Title: Azure App Service—.NET Core 3.1 is now generally available

Body.Content:
.NET Core 3.1 LTS is now generally available on Azure App Service for Linux and Windows applications. If you’re running .NET Core 3.0 applications, which had its end-of-life date on March 3, 2020, update to .NET Core 3.1 and create applications in the App Service portal now.

Learn more.
